Island_167.terrain_character: An outward-facing maritime industrial region with a large primary island and nearby satellites, giving room for engineered shorelines, quarries, cut roads, workshops, rail corridors, redstone districts, dry docks, and resource-processing areas without occupying the realm's political center.
Island_167.settlement_role: Working port towns, engineering yards, foundries, redstone workshops, warehouses, worker districts, test grounds, and practical infrastructure clustered around the main island and its satellite harbors.
Island_167.primary_function: Engineering, industry, large-scale production, and maritime infrastructure
Island_167.secondary_feature: Dry docks, rail and minecart corridors, quarries, redstone works, workshops, cargo ports, test sites and utility districts
Island_167.travel_role: An off-center production region with strong sea connections to the Grand Exchange and Crownlands; it should export finished goods and engineered systems rather than act as the realm's historic crossroads.
Island_167.lore_notes: Engineer's Reach grew at the edge of the settled core where there was enough land and coastline to build loudly, experiment, quarry, ship, and expand. Its identity comes from practical ingenuity and production, not political prestige.
